repair.title: Clean Power Keeps Growing
repair.summary: Renewables supplied about 32 percent of global electricity in 2024, with the share projected to rise through 2030.
repair.why_it_matters: The energy system is not fixed in place; infrastructure can shift when technology, policy, and cost line up.
repair.caveat: Electricity is only part of total energy use, and grid buildout remains a serious bottleneck.
